P2 2D row-slice src + fp32->bf16 cast copies are VALID on ascendc (t3i2's broken form is column-slice src)
P3 copy_ub_to_gm is single-template-type: no dtype cast on the UB->GM path; bf16 stores must stage through a UB->UB cast (copy_ub_to_ub has the Cast path)

P5 Expert-mode probes must carry ALL adjacent set/wait pairs (zero-flag probes read garbage)
P6 AUTO_CV_SYNC pairs buffers by 'workspace' name substring: Expert kernels must keep ws_* (substring-free) names to avoid double sync
